newsitem.title: USA: Dekalb sees international seed profits doubling.
newsitem.headline: Dekalb sees international seed profits doubling.

text.p: DeKalb Genetics Corp said Wednesday it expects profits at its international seed operation to be almost double the levels posted in 1996.
In a statement issued by the company after a meeting with investors, DeKalb also said it expected its North American corn volume to be about three million units this year.

"Our North American corn business continues to post increases in volume, market share, and unit margins," said DeKalb Chairman and Chief Executive Bruce Bickner in the statement. "We expect North American corn volume to be in the neighborhood of three million units this year, the highest in 17 years."
"Meanwhile, our international seed operation will report record profits, which will be almost double the 1996 contribution," he added.
The agricultural genetics and biotechnology company said its financial and operating results have improved due to "a single-minded focus" on the seed business, especially corn.
